products.product_description: Stringless Sugar Snap Peas, Sunny Shores' Mann's. Net Wt 8 oz (227 g); Perishable, Preservative Free, keep refrigerated. Product of Guatemala UPC 7 16519 13004 Distributed by Mann Packing, Salinas, CA.
products.reason_for_recall: California Department of Food and Agriculture randomly sampled Sunny Shores Mann's snap peas and found them to contain 0.278 and 0.195 ppm of Carbendazim. Carbendazim is a pesticide that is not allowed in the US but is approved for use in the EU>
